paragraphs.text: Authors are required to disclose their utilization of generative AI and AI-assisted technologies in their manuscript preparation process. Authors should employ the following statement format: "During the preparation of this work the author(s) used [NAME TOOL/SERVICE] in order to [REASON]. After using this tool/service, the author(s) reviewed and edited the content as needed and take(s) full responsibility for the content of the publication." It is important to note that this declaration requirement does not extend to the use of fundamental writing assistance tools such as grammar checkers, spelling validators, or reference management software. In cases where no generative AI or AI-assisted technologies were employed, authors may omit this declaration section entirely.

References should be in the Vancouver style, and only in English. Please ensure that all references in the text are also included in the reference list.  Use the Arabic number in parentheses after the statement.
